firstexhotic/ai-applyd.name: score_resume
firstexhotic/ai-applyd.description: Score a resume against a job description for ATS compatibility. Returns keyword match score, missing keywords, section scores, and improvement recommendations. Deterministic keyword scoring, uses no AI credits, but requires a connected AI Applyd account.

job_description.description: Full text of the job description

firstexhotic/ai-applyd.name: analyze_job_description
firstexhotic/ai-applyd.description: Analyze a job description to extract required skills, nice-to-haves, red flags, and estimated seniority level. Deterministic analysis, uses no AI credits, but requires a connected AI Applyd account.

job_description.description: Full text of the job description

firstexhotic/ai-applyd.name: score_resume_ai
firstexhotic/ai-applyd.description: AI-powered ATS scoring with detailed section-by-section feedback, gap analysis, requirement mapping, and keyword strategy. Provide a job_description to score against a specific posting, or omit it for a general ATS readiness score. Requires authentication -- sign in at https://aiapplyd.com first. Free alternative: use score_resume for keyword-based scoring.

job_description.description: Full text of the job description (optional -- omit for a general ATS readiness score)

firstexhotic/ai-applyd.name: optimize_resume
firstexhotic/ai-applyd.description: AI-powered resume optimization. Rewrites your resume to be more ATS-compatible and returns the optimized content plus a summary of changes. Provide a job_description to tailor the rewrite to a specific posting, or omit it for general ATS optimization. Requires authentication.

resume_text.description: Full text of the resume to optimize

job_description.description: Full text of the target job description (optional -- omit for general ATS optimization)

firstexhotic/ai-applyd.name: generate_interview_questions
firstexhotic/ai-applyd.description: AI-powered interview preparation. Generates company insights, STAR scenarios, likely questions with approach guidance, talking points, questions to ask, and negotiation prep. Requires authentication.

job_title.description: Title of the position (e.g. "Senior Software Engineer")

job_description.description: Full text of the job description (optional but recommended for better results)

firstexhotic/ai-applyd.name: translate_resume
firstexhotic/ai-applyd.description: Translate a resume into a target language using AI. Creates a translated copy saved to your account. Requires authentication.

resume_text.description: Full text of the resume to translate

firstexhotic/ai-applyd.name: search_jobs
firstexhotic/ai-applyd.description: Search for job matches based on title, location, and remote preference. Returns AI-curated job listings with match scores, companies, and application URLs. Note: this tool updates your AI Applyd job-match preferences with the supplied filters so future matches reflect them. Requires authentication.

job_title.description: Job title to search for (e.g. "Software Engineer", "Product Manager")

remote_only.description: If true, only show remote-friendly positions

firstexhotic/ai-applyd.name: generate_cover_letter
firstexhotic/ai-applyd.description: AI-powered cover letter generation tailored to a specific job. Provide your resume, the job description, and company name. Returns a personalized cover letter with key themes. Requires paid plan (Hired in 30+).

company_name.description: Name of the company you are applying to

job_description.description: Full text of the target job description

firstexhotic/ai-applyd.name: auto_apply
firstexhotic/ai-applyd.description: Automatically apply to a job using AI. Tailors your resume, generates a cover letter, and submits the application. Provide the job URL and optionally your resume text. Requires paid plan (Hired in 30+).

job_url.description: URL of the job posting to apply to

resume_text.description: Full text of your resume (uses your default resume if not provided)

firstexhotic/ai-applyd.name: build_pdf
firstexhotic/ai-applyd.description: Generate a professional PDF resume from text. Choose from modern, classic, or minimal templates. The PDF is saved to your account with a shareable link. Requires paid plan (Hired in 30+).

resume_text.description: Full text of the resume to convert to PDF
